# telnyx_voice_designs (Data Source)

Lists voice designs, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_voice_design`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `-name`, `created_at`, `name`.

### Read-Only

- `voice_designs` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--voice_designs))

<a id="nestedatt--voice_designs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `voice_designs`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the voice design was first created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the voice design.
- `name` (String) Name of the voice design.
- `provider` (String) Voice synthesis provider used for this design.
- `provider_supported_models` (List of String) List of TTS model identifiers supported by this design's provider.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the resource type.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the voice design was last updated.
